in_sanskrit.name: विभास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विभास्ति जानति सर्वम् - He who knows everything by its sparkle

in_hindi.name: विभाश
in_hindi.meaning: तेज, अलोक, ज्योतिर्मयता, विशालता - Spark, light, radiance, vastness
in_hindi.long_meaning: विभाश का जीवन के साथ विचित्रता, उज्ज्वलता और विशालता होती है - The name Vibhas is associated with the traits of diversity, brilliance, and vastness in life.

in_tamil.name: விபாஷ
in_tamil.meaning: விசாரணை, விவசாயம், கீழ்விடம் - Inquiry, curiosity, depth
in_tamil.long_meaning: விபாஷின் ஜிவனத்தின் விசாரணையில் ஒரு உலகம் அவசரவில்லையால், அவர்கள் விவசாயம் அல்லவாய் விளக்கினார்கள் - The name Vibhas signifies the inquisitive and curious nature of a person, who explores the depths of the world around them.

in_telugu.name: విభశ
in_telugu.meaning: శోజయ, ప్రభావ, జ్యోతిశ్చన్ద్ర, మూద్దేశ - Shining, radiance, brightness, brilliance
in_telugu.long_meaning: విభశమీద జీవనమీద శోజయ, ప్రభావ, జ్యోతిశ్చన్ద్ర, మూద్దేశయోజీయోజీయోజీయోజీ - The name Vibhas is a reflection of the shining, radiant, and brilliant nature of a person's life.

in_marathi.name: Vibhas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vibhas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vibhas means 'blessings' or 'prosperity' in Hinduism. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vibhāva', which means 'expansion' or 'manifestation'. The name is often used to signify abundance and success in life.
